mapper.sql: id, supplier_id, template_id, evaluate_json, evaluate_date, score, score_rating
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, s.short_name AS supplier_short_name, e.template_id, e.evaluate_json, e.serial_number, e.evaluate_date, e.score, e.score_rating, e.classify_id, e.column_map_json, e.user_id, u.name AS evaluator_name, e.review_status, e.approve_record_id, e.reviewer_id, e.reviewer_name, e.review_time FROM scm_supplier_evaluate e LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON e.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON e.user_id = u.id WHERE e.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND e.review_status = 2 AND YEAR(e.review_time) = #{year} ORDER BY e.review_time desc ,e.id desc LIMIT 1
